profiles_seats_doctor: Button under the profile cards, and title of the dialog that lists the seat health checks. Doctor is the name of that diagnostics tool.
profiles_seats_intro: Opening paragraph of the Seats dialog; a docs link follows it.
profiles_seats_prepare: Button in the Seats dialog when Windows lacks the Remote Desktop Session Host role; installs it and turns seats on.
profiles_seats_prepare_hint: Under the 'Set up Remote Desktop' button. Remote Desktop Session Host and Per User are Windows names.
profiles_seats_preparing: Label of the 'Set up Remote Desktop' button while it works, and of the password dialog's submit button during it.
profiles_seats_next: Line at the bottom of the Seats dialog once seats are on. 'Add profile' and 'Own desktop' are the page button and the choice card.
profiles_doctor_box: Heading in the Doctor dialog over the checks of the whole PC, as opposed to one seat's.
profiles_doctor_seat: Heading in the Doctor dialog over one seat's checks when the seat has no profile name to show.
profiles_doctor_again: Button in the Doctor dialog; runs all checks again.
profiles_doctor_notes: Line under the profile cards on a seat host: seats work, but the Doctor has warnings. count: number of warnings.
pairing_approve_profile: Line in the approve dialog with the person's avatar. name: the profile name the device asks to play as.
seat_whose_library: aria-label of the dropdown in the Library page title that picks whose library to show.
seat_whose_plugins: aria-label of the dropdown in the Plugins page title that picks whose plugins to show.
seat_library_of: Option in the Library page's title dropdown, and the page title once picked. name: a person on this host.
seat_plugins_of: Option in the Plugins page's title dropdown, and the page title once picked. name: a person on this host.
seat_box: Stands in for the owner's name when the owner has none; fills the name slot in messages such as the library title.
seat_note: Badge on a library page that edits someone else's library. name: the person whose library it is.
seat_open_profiles: Link after a seat error message; opens the Profiles page.
profiles_door: Switch above the profile cards on Linux, and title of its password dialog. A door lets a paired device start a user's session while the PC is locked.
profiles_door_hint: Under the 'Reachable without logging in' switch, and body of the dialog that turns it on; a docs link follows.
profiles_door_games: Linux, under the door switch while it is on. The path is literal. Seats are the profiles' own desktops.
profiles_door_off_hint: Body of the password dialog that turns 'Reachable without logging in' off; a docs link follows.
profiles_door_on: Verb. Submit button of the door password dialog when turning the switch on.
profiles_door_off: Verb. Submit button of the door password dialog when turning the switch off.
profiles_door_switching: Shown with a spinner in place of the door switch while it changes.
profiles_door_failed: Error line in the door password dialog, and a toast, when switching fails. The host log is a file on the host.
profiles_door_slow: Error toast when the door switch takes over two minutes; the console restarts with the host.
profiles_outcome_door_off: Description on the disabled 'Own desktop' card on Linux; 'Reachable without logging in' is the switch above the cards.
profiles_outcome_desktop_hint_linux: Description on the 'Own desktop' choice card on Linux with the door on.
profiles_remove_linux: Sentence appended to the remove dialog's body after 'Sessions playing as {name} end now.', Linux. name: the profile's name.
profiles_seat_account: Heading of a choice group in Add profile, Windows, under 'Own desktop': which Windows account the desktop runs on.
profiles_seat_account_new: Choice card under 'Windows account': Punktfunk creates the account.
profiles_seat_account_new_hint: Description on the 'New account' card. pf_seat1 to pf_seat4 are literal account names.
profiles_seat_account_existing: Choice card under 'Windows account': use an account already on the PC.
profiles_seat_account_existing_hint: Description on the 'Existing account' card. A standard account is a non-administrator Windows account.
profiles_seat_account_none: Description on the disabled 'Existing account' card in place of its usual one, when no account is free.
profiles_seat_password: Label of the password field in Add profile for an existing Windows account.
profiles_seat_account_lock: Under that password field. A seat is the profile's own desktop; 'Remove the profile' refers to the trash button on its row.
profiles_seat_account_line: Second gray line on a Windows profile row. account: the Windows account's name.
profiles_remove_adopted: Sentence appended to the remove dialog's body, Windows, for a profile on an existing account. account: the account's name.
profiles_seat_password_update: Tooltip and screen-reader label of the key button on a Windows profile row; opens a dialog, hence the ellipsis.
profiles_seat_password_title: Title of the dialog that updates a seat account's password. name: the profile's name.
profiles_seat_password_body: Label above the password field in that dialog. account: the Windows account's name.
profiles_seat_password_save: Submit button of the update-password dialog.
profiles_seat_password_failed: Error line in the update-password dialog when the host gave no reason.
profiles_seat_account_linux: Heading of a choice group in Add profile, Linux, under 'Own desktop': which user account the desktop runs on.
profiles_seat_account_new_hint_linux: Description on the 'New account' card, Linux. pf-seat-1 to pf-seat-4 are literal user names.
profiles_seat_account_existing_hint_linu: Description on the 'Existing account' card, Linux. 'Someone' is a person who already has a login on this machine.
profiles_account_which_linux: Label of the text field where the existing user's name is typed in Add profile, Linux.
profiles_account_name_linux: Under the 'User name' field. A directory account is one managed by a company login server; the example is literal.
profiles_seat_password_linux: Label of the password field in Add profile, Linux. 'Their' is the person whose account it is.
profiles_seat_account_lock_linux: Under the Linux password field. 'It' is the password; 'they' is the account's person. Fingerprint or face is device unlock.
profiles_seat_account_line_linux: Second gray line on a Linux profile row. account: the user name.
profiles_remove_adopted_linux: Sentence appended to the remove dialog's body, Linux, for a profile on an existing account. account: the user name.
profiles_seat_password_kept: Under the Windows password field in Add profile; says the PC stores the password, encrypted.
profiles_devices_title: Heading of the list under a Linux profile row that uses a person's own account: the devices signed in to it.
profiles_devices_trust: Paragraph under the 'Signed-in devices' heading. account: the account's user name.
profiles_devices_none: Empty state of the 'Signed-in devices' list.
profiles_device_for_now: Status under a device's name in the list, joined with the last-used text by ' · '. The sign-in lasts only for now.
profiles_device_stay: Status under a device's name in the list: the sign-in is kept until the device is signed out.
profiles_device_key: Status under a device's name in the list: the device opens the desktop by its own fingerprint or face unlock.
profiles_device_last_used: Under a device's name in the list. when: a formatted date and time.
profiles_device_sign_out: Verb. Button on each device row, and confirm button of its dialog.
profiles_device_sign_out_title: Title of the confirm dialog for signing out one device. device: the device's name.
profiles_device_sign_out_body: Body of that dialog. account: the account's user name.
profiles_devices_sign_out_all: Verb. Button above the device list, and confirm button of its dialog.
profiles_devices_sign_out_all_title: Title of the confirm dialog for signing out every device of the profile.
profiles_devices_sign_out_all_body: Body of that dialog. account: the account's user name.
profiles_devices_failed: Error toast when signing a device out fails and the host gave no reason.
seat_own_unmanaged: Note on the Library and Store pages for a person on a Linux desktop of their own. name: that person.
seat_own_verified: Note on the Store page for a person on a Windows desktop of their own. name: that person.
display_preset_gaming_rig_hint: Line under the 'Headless box' preset card. Host has no monitor; whoever connects next takes over.
display_preset_shared_desktop_hint: Line under the 'Desk PC' preset card.
display_preset_play_together_hint: Line under the 'Play together' preset card.
